meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 对网页/终端/分页文档界面截图或抓终端输出,跑像素/宽度差异,并行派两个只读审查查设计系统完整性与 CJK/视觉保真度,给出通过/修改/不通过结论。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何界面之后,或当被问及页面/组件/终端界面是否看着正确时触发;也响应“视觉 QA”“像素差异”“文本被裁”等关键词。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页,帮我跑一遍 visual QA。
say.note: 会截图并由两个审查检查后给结论。

say.text: 对照参考图,检查这个页面是否像素级一致。
say.note: 需要提供参考图,它会做像素对比。

say.text: 这个终端界面有边框错位或文字被裁吗?
say.note: 会抓终端渲染并检查宽度与对齐。

howto.what_en: Claude screenshots web/TUI/paginated-document UIs or captures terminal output, runs pixel/width diffs, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system integrity; visual fidelity/CJK), and returns a pass/revise/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, or when asked whether a page/component/TUI looks right. Also responds to keywords like visual QA, pixel diff, clipped text.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page; run a visual QA on it.
say_en.note: Screenshots and dispatches reviewers, then gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Compare this page against the reference image for pixel-level fidelity.
say_en.note: It will pixel-diff the two captures.

say_en.text: Does this TUI have border misalignment or clipped text?
say_en.note: It captures terminal render and checks width/alignment.
